title: Refuse a recursive delete whose target the guard cannot resolve, or that sweeps a shared temp root, its parent or a glob directly under it, with the same rule and wording on the client and the engine; teach removing a mktemp directory in the call that creates it.
verification: Candidate regression tests run both guards: the shared-temp glob incident command, unresolved command substitution and variables, same-call mktemp cleanup, the session scratch directory and named temp paths; no deployed proof yet.
